sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Search is a Practical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The search skill mastering allows you to search bodies and containers faster and more efficiently.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- This skill currently offers no search speed improvements other than its Elite level perk, since search speed is dependant on the Attention skill.
- The Elite level perk allows you to search two "item containers", like Chest rigs and Backpacks simultaneously.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Level 9 of this skill is needed for the quest Scavenger

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases search speed (1% per level → +50% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Search two containers at a time

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Searching Loot containers and corpses
- Picking up loose loot
- Completing the quest Bullshit
- Completing the quest Get a Foothold
- Completing the quest Profit Retention
- Completing the quest Night Sweep
